tools.name: search_skus
tools.description: Find VPS plans, GPU instances or LLM models by name/id substring, category (vps|gpu|llm) and provider. Active SKUs on the provider's public price page or product API by default (listing filter). Returns each match's current list price, listing_status, unit and currency, verified_at, stale flag and s

tools.name: get_price
tools.description: Current list price of one SKU (id like vps/ovhcloud/vps-2027-model2 or llm/official/anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5) with all secondary prices, USD/EUR equivalents, spec, source URL, verified_at, a stale flag that is true when the source's latest fetch failed (the price shown is then the last verified o

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: Price change points of a SKU over the last N days (default 90): each row is when a price started to hold, with USD/EUR and the FX rate used. Rows are change points, not daily samples. Returns an error object for an unknown id.

tools.name: list_changes
tools.description: Dated price changes, new SKUs, delistings and spec changes, newest first. Each row says when the change was first seen and the previous good snapshot it is measured against, plus the source id. Filter by since (ISO date), kind, category and provider.

tools.name: cheapest_for_spec
tools.description: Cheapest active SKUs meeting a minimum spec, ranked by list price only (no sponsorship, no affiliate weighting), excl. VAT (VAT-inclusive plans are ranked after removing their stated VAT rate; rank.vat_basis says so). gpu and vps default to commitment=on-demand: spot, reserved, committed, dynamic an

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: Itemised cost of a usage profile at the SKU's current list price: tokens (input/output/cached) for LLM SKUs, hours/months for instances. Returns line items with the rates used, native, USD and EUR totals, verified_at and source_url. Pure arithmetic on stored prices; excl. VAT unless the result says

tools.name: get_index
tools.description: A named daily index series (e.g. eu-vps-floor-2c4g, h100-list-median, frontier-input-floor) with its latest value, the number of constituents and the constituents themselves, so the value can be recomputed. Omit series to list all series with their latest values.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_price" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
